name: makeReservation
intent: Reserve the selected loaned copy for the selected user.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
A book copy with the supplied barcode exists.
The copy is not marked as reserved.
post: Mark the new reservation as open.
Set the reservation date to today.
Link the new reservation to the selected user.
Link the new reservation to the selected copy.
Add the new reservation to the user's reservations.
Add the new reservation to the copy's reservation records.
Store the new reservation among the system's reservations.
difficulty_basis: New reservation plus user/copy associations and reserved-state update.
scenarios: All creation, date, links, memberships, flags and true result checked.
effects_audit: No borrowing-status/quota guard, reservation ID uniqueness or change from LOANED to ONHOLDSHELF inferred.
